purpose: Defines civilization-specific scientific competence and derives one grounded project-readiness value from actual knowledge, facilities, evidence, and tacit expertise instead of stacking arbitrary percentage bonuses.

theoretical.meaning: Ability to understand, model, criticize, and extend the field's concepts.

experimental.meaning: Ability to design measurements, operate experiments, distinguish signal from error, and reproduce results.

engineering.meaning: Ability to turn principles into reliable manufacturable systems and operate them at scale.

competence_bands.name: Unfamiliar
competence_bands.description: Little active institutional competence in this field.

competence_bands.name: Developing
competence_bands.description: Working knowledge exists but difficult work requires significant learning.

competence_bands.name: Established
competence_bands.description: Mature institutions and repeatable practice exist.

competence_bands.name: Advanced
competence_bands.description: Civilization has deep active expertise and can work efficiently near its current frontier.

competence_bands.name: Frontier
competence_bands.description: Field is among the civilization's strongest active scientific/engineering traditions; this does not imply all future discoveries are known.

related_field_transfer.rule: Meaningful work in a field can create limited competence in explicitly related fields, but transfer is always smaller than direct work and cannot substitute for required evidence/facilities.

growth_rules.disproven_hypothesis_value: Raises relevant theoretical/experimental competence because knowing what is false narrows the scientific search space.

atrophy_and_preservation.theoretical_atrophy: slow; preserved publications/archives maintain a substantial floor
atrophy_and_preservation.engineering_atrophy: fastest when manufacturing, maintenance, and deployment practice disappears
atrophy_and_preservation.rule: Atrophy reduces active readiness, not whether already mature technology is historically known. Rebuilding dormant expertise should be easier than discovering the field from nothing when records survive.

project_field_readiness.default_field_weighting: equal unless a node/project profile explicitly overrides it
project_field_readiness.reason: A project spanning several disciplines should be constrained by a serious competence gap rather than allowing excellence in one field to completely average away ignorance in another.

facility_readiness.source: eligible assigned lab/facility capability and specialization

evidence_readiness.source: quality/relevance of required or supporting evidence; neutral for ordinary established domestic engineering

tacit_expertise.source: expert cohorts, operating institutions, manufacturing know-how, foreign technical assistance; neutral when not relevant

project_readiness.reason: Research Pressure governs recognized need/availability where explicitly configured. It must not also become a hidden speed bonus.
